notes.title: Simplified Chinese has been added to The Clinic of Depravity!
notes.content:
Simplified Chinese has been added to The Clinic of Depravity - A Wife Reveals Her True Nature in Front of Her Husband -.

[How to play the Simplified Chinese version]
1. Open your Steam Library.
2. Right click the game's title and select Properties.
3. Select "Simplified Chinese" from the language list and launch the game.
(*Update required.)

notes.title: 「淫墮諮商～在丈夫面前展現本性的妻子」繁體版已於Steam發行！
notes.content:
「淫墮諮商～在丈夫面前展現本性的妻子」繁體版已於Steam發行！可別錯過囉！

【繁體中文版的遊玩方式】
開啟Steam收藏庫，按右鍵點選遊戲名稱並選擇內容。
在語言選單中選擇「繁體中文」，更新遊戲後即可遊玩繁體中文版。

[How to play the Traditional Chinese version]
1. Open your Steam Library.
2. Right click the game's title and select Properties.
3. Select "Traditional Chinese" from the language list and launch the game.
(*You need to update the game.)
